description: What do gamblers and referees have in common? When do machines make better decisions than people? And has Stephen been replaced by a computer? Hosted by Simplecast, an AdsWizz company. See pcm.adswizz.com for information about our collection and use of personal data for advertising.
classificationReason: The episode centers on replacing human umpires with robots and compares machine versus human decisions.
qualityReason: A sustained, original discussion connects robotic umpire systems with algorithmic accuracy, human bias, trust, control, and adoption, using studies, examples, and contrasting perspectives.
